meta.title: Analog IPC (2019 GT 401A, KR3T-14C026-AC) CAN message notes
meta.description: Every CAN ID the analog cluster receives or transmits, from its firmware (kr3t_com_extract.py), with names from database.md / the Ford DBC and real payloads from this car's freeze frame. Edit required_bytes / notes here; everything else is regenerated.

messages.name: APIM power mode (required to boot the APIM)
Steering angle, Track Apps g meter
Vehicle speed / yaw, steering warning fix
messages.notes: **Cruise set speed: byte 4** (GWM copy of Veh_V_DsplyCcSet), 1 - 253 shown as sent, FE / FF invalid (getter 0x053C02, telltale 0x01BF5A). Byte 5 bit 1 is a cruise flag (0x01BF2A). See KR3T_NOTES.md

wrench.need: received at least every 5000 ms with byte3 bit0 = 1

messages.name: APIM status, clears the digital cluster's U0253

messages.init_bytes: FF FD FF FD FF FD 00 00
FF FD FF FD FF FD 00 00
AA 00 AA AA AA AA A8 00

messages.name: Cluster on (required, send first), doors, lights, parking brake
TPMS lamp, system status, per-tire status
Tire pressure
messages.init_bytes: FF FD FF FD FF FD FF FD

messages.name: Occupant sensor blocked, battery icon, U0401-82, PCM present
messages.notes: Byte 0 bits 7 - 5 cruise status / icon (getter 0x054A92). No set speed here, that is 0x077 byte 4

messages.name: AFR, cylinder head temp, boost / vacuum
GWM present (stops U0146), wrench input: byte 3 must be `08`
Cluster_HEV_Data10_FD1
messages.init_bytes: FF EF FE FF FF FF FF FF
